issues.reason: A plural NP is a group — "a plural referred to as a unit is a group (GroupOf g <kind>)" — and the plural-modifier rule assumes exactly that shape ("(GroupOf sk_group_1 breton_tapestry)"), so a single (Member sk_repair_1 repair) records one repair where the text has several.

"On a plural, ... a descriptive modifier distributes over the members exactly like a copular predicate", and "a bare (Member <group> <prop>) appears only for a property genuinely of the collection itself (its size, its name)" — `large` is a property of each repair.

new_gaps: The object of an intensional verb ("requires / needs large repairs") is minted as an existential witness by the indefinite-argument rule, so the parse asserts at top level that the repairs EXIST, which "requires" does not state; the instruction set has no non-existential encoding for an intensional object.
repair_summary: Re-encoded the plural object as a group, (GroupOf sk_repair_1 repair) in place of (Member sk_repair_1 repair); replaced the group-level (Member sk_repair_1 large) with the licensed distribution rule (Implication (PartOf $x sk_repair_1) (Member $x large)) (STV 1.0 0.9).
notes: Everything the reviewer's note approves is left untouched — Agent for the stative-transitive subject, Theme for the unchanged object, `large` un-fused (size is incidental description), and no tense atom on the simple present.
